content.text:
I've built the site as a single page, `index.html`, in the project folder next to `images/`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested. The script that generated the page printed the item counts below, which match the content in `copy.md`.

- **Content:** it has all 8 categories, 4 trending products, 4 recent reviews, the 38 award winners, 5 articles, the "How it works" steps, the about text and the rewards sign-up. The header, the footer and every link to tellmebaby.com.au come from `copy.md`.
- **Images:** the hero uses `image-02.jpg`, the Sunrice banner is the ad strip, and the peach dots and `picture-alt.png` appear in the rewards box and footer. The `pixel.png` product images are 1×1 placeholders, so I used a small peach accent bar on each card instead.
- **Look:** I took the peach (#FFAA91) and charcoal from the logo, and the page has a dark mode and works at phone width.
- **Search boxes:** the hero search form doesn't do anything yet. I didn't know the site's search URL.
- **Footer:** the four footer column headings in `copy.md` had no content under them. I kept "Tell Me Baby" and "Community" with links to pages already on the page, and dropped "Brands" and "Here to help".
- **Header navigation:** "Tools" scrolls to the "How it works" section because there was no Tools page to link to. "Browse reviews", "Our community" and "Articles" scroll to their sections on the page.
